snippet.title: Follyvale – Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
A wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or sometimes get in your way.

Play the free demo and wishlist Follyvale on Steam.
